name: Atto's Territory
player_description: Atto is fourteen. Half-Roman, half-Germanic. He is not a building or a place — he is wherever the walls meet the outside. He can be found at the drainage channel behind the east granary, at the gap between the workshop row and the palisade, or pressed against the fort's exterior wall listening. He has never been inside the fort. He knows more about it than most soldiers.
gm_notes: Atto is the most useful contact in the vicus if the party reaches DC 16 with him before Session 4. He knows: which drainage channel runs under the southwest corner; which postern door can be lifted free from outside with a specific motion; which section of the north wall has loose-mortared stone; exactly which arc each watchtower covers and where those arcs do not overlap. None of this was acquired through spying. He is fourteen. He explored. He tells adults nothing about this unless they treat him as someone worth talking to — not as a child, not as an asset. As a person. DC 12 Persuasion (treating him as a peer): he talks. DC 14: he describes one structural vulnerability. DC 16: he offers to guide one party member through the drainage channel in Session 4, once. He will not go twice. He speaks Latin, Germanic, and some Gallic.
